notes.moveMode: control method: PCC, PCC_Cable, Poly, or PD_test (DISCONNECT TENDONS FOR PD_test)
notes.trajectory: tip path, see Core/trajectories.py calcTargGlob: 0 horizontal circle, 1 vertical spiral, 2 vertical rotate, 3 controller input, 4 full circle, 5 butterfly, 7 figure 8, 8 3D helix, 9 step-return C-shape, 10 step-return S-shape
notes.pdTestMode: PD_test motor profile: ramp or sine
notes.taskTime: s, length of the periodic trajectories (0, 1, 2, 4, 7, 8). Trajectory 3 runs 1000 s, 5 runs 100 s, 9 and 10 set their own length
notes.movementFreq: repetitions of the periodic trajectories within taskTime
notes.setupTime: s, moving into the t = 0 position before the task (logged, t = -2 -> 0)
notes.setupHoldTime: s, held at the start of setupTime (motors at zero) and at its end (at the t = 0 motor positions)
notes.packupTime: s, ramp back to zero after the task
notes.packupHoldTime: s, held at zero after the pack-up ramp, before disabling
